title: Successful login redirects to dashboard
description: Verifies a user can log in with valid credentials and is redirected into the authenticated dashboard area.

title: Invalid password shows an authentication error and stays on login
description: Verifies an incorrect password results in a visible error message and the user remains on the login page.

title: Non-existent user shows an authentication error and stays on login
description: Verifies a non-existent account cannot log in and an error is displayed without leaving /login.

title: Missing email prevents login and shows a validation/auth error
description: Verifies submitting the login form without an email does not log in and shows a visible error state.

title: Open a new shift successfully from the Shift page
description: Verifies a cashier can open a shift with an initial cash amount and the status updates to OPEN.

steps.description: Click the "Sign in" or "Log in" button
Click on "Shift" in the main navigation menu

title: Open shift submit updates status to OPEN
description: Verifies that submitting an initial cash amount completes shift opening and shows an OPEN active shift status.

steps.description: Click the "Sign in" or "Log in" button
Click on "Shift" in the main navigation menu
Type "100" into the initial cash amount field

title: After opening a shift, active status shows OPEN on Shift page
description: Verifies the Shift page displays the active shift as OPEN after a successful open shift submission.

steps.description: Click the "Sign in" or "Log in" button
Click on "Shift" in the main navigation menu

title: Active shift status is visible on Shift page
description: Verifies the Shift page shows an active shift status section that is visible to the user.

steps.description: Click the "Sign in" or "Log in" button
Click on "Shift" in the main navigation menu
Verify element "Active shift status" is visible

title: Successful checkout with quantity adjustment and percent discount
description: Verifies a cashier can add a product, adjust quantity via Smart Numpad, apply a percent discount, pay, and reach an invoice result screen.

steps.description: Click a product category tab or category option

title: Adjust cart item quantity using Smart Numpad
description: Verifies Smart Numpad can be opened and used to change the quantity of an item already in the cart.

steps.description: Click a product tile/card in the product grid
Click the cart item row to focus/select it
Click a number on the numpad to set a larger quantity
Verify the selected cart item shows an updated quantity value

title: Apply a fixed amount discount and verify total updates
description: Verifies a fixed amount discount can be applied and the displayed total reflects the discount.

steps.description: Click a product tile/card in the product grid
Click the "Discount" button or discount input area
Type "5" into the discount amount field

title: Complete checkout with a single payment method
description: Verifies checkout submission succeeds with a single payment method and results in an invoice result view.

steps.description: Click a product tile/card in the product grid
Click the "Payment method" selector or payment method section
Select a single payment method option (for example, Cash or Card)
Verify element "View invoice" or "Invoice details" is visible

title: Checkout blocked when no active shift is open
description: Verifies the POS shows a validation error indicating an open shift is required when attempting to checkout without an active shift.

steps.description: Click a product tile/card in the product grid
Click the "Payment method" selector or payment method section
Select a single payment method option (for example, Cash or Card)
Verify text "checkout requires open shift" is visible

title: Split payment error when parts do not equal total
description: Verifies split payment validation triggers when the entered split amounts do not match the transaction total.

steps.description: Click a product tile/card in the product grid
Type "1" into the first split amount field
Click the "Add payment part" or "Add split" button
Type "1" into the second split amount field
Verify text "split payment amounts do not equal total" is visible

title: Create a new product and verify it appears in inventory list
description: Verifies an authenticated user can create a product with name, price, and stock and see it listed in inventory.

steps.description: Click on "Inventory" in the main navigation

title: Create product form validation for missing required fields
description: Verifies the create product form shows validation errors when submitting without required fields.

steps.description: Click on "Inventory" in the main navigation

title: Cashier cannot create a product (authorization error)
description: Verifies a CASHIER user is blocked from creating products and sees an authorization error message.

steps.description: Wait for the page to finish loading
Click on "Inventory" in the main navigation
Verify text "Not authorized" or "Permission" is visible

title: View invoice list and open an invoice detail page
description: Verifies an authenticated user can view the invoice list and open an invoice detail view.

steps.description: Click on the "Sign in" or "Log in" button
Click on "Invoices" in the main navigation
Click on the first invoice in the invoice list

title: Filter invoices by status and open a filtered invoice detail
description: Verifies status filtering updates the list and a filtered invoice can be opened in the detail view.

steps.description: Click on the "Sign in" or "Log in" button
Click on "Invoices" in the main navigation
Select "Paid" from the status filter dropdown
Click on the first invoice in the invoice list

title: Filter invoices by date range and open an invoice detail
description: Verifies date range filtering keeps the user on the invoices list and allows opening a resulting invoice detail.

steps.description: Click on the "Sign in" or "Log in" button
Click on "Invoices" in the main navigation
Click on the first invoice in the invoice list

title: Invalid date range shows validation error and stays on invoice list
description: Verifies the UI blocks an invalid date range (From later than To) and shows a visible validation message without leaving the list.

steps.description: Click on the "Sign in" or "Log in" button
Click on "Invoices" in the main navigation
Verify text "Invalid date range" is visible

title: Clear status filter returns user to unfiltered invoice list view
description: Verifies the user can remove a status filter and continue using the invoice list.

steps.description: Click on the "Sign in" or "Log in" button
Click on "Invoices" in the main navigation
Select "Unpaid" from the status filter dropdown
Click on the "Clear" or "Reset filters" button

title: Invoice list empty state after restrictive filters
description: Verifies the invoices page shows a clear empty-state message when filters return no results.

steps.description: Click on the "Sign in" or "Log in" button
Click on "Invoices" in the main navigation

title: Invoice detail view shows key sections and stays stable on refresh-like revisit
description: Verifies opening an invoice detail shows key visible sections and can be re-opened from the list without losing context.

steps.description: Click on the "Sign in" or "Log in" button
Click on "Invoices" in the main navigation
Click on the first invoice in the invoice list
Click on "Invoices" in the main navigation
Click on the first invoice in the invoice list

title: View financial report for a selected period and valid date range
description: Verifies a logged-in user can select a reporting period/date range and see aggregated charts and summary cards.

title: Select report period and date range then see chart and summary update
description: Verifies submitting a chosen period/date range shows visible aggregated chart and summary cards for that selection.

steps.description: Select "This month" from the report period dropdown
Click the "Apply" or "Submit" button for the period selection

title: Add a new expense and see it reflected in the reports view
description: Verifies an authorized user can add an expense entry and see it listed with totals reflecting the new entry.

title: Submit expense form with typical valid values
description: Verifies the expense creation form accepts valid inputs and confirms the new expense is visible in the list.

title: Expense appears in list after submission
description: Verifies the UI shows a success state and the newly created expense entry is visible in the reports list.

steps.description: Click the "Submit" or "Save" button on the expense form

title: Invalid date range shows validation error (from date later than to date)
description: Verifies the report filter prevents submission of an invalid date range and displays a visible validation error.

steps.description: Click the "Apply" or "Submit" button for the period selection

title: Validation error message is visible for invalid date range
description: Verifies a clear, visible validation message is shown when the date range is invalid.

steps.description: Verify text "invalid date range" is visible

title: Cashier role is blocked from adding an expense (role restriction)
description: Verifies that a cashier cannot create an expense and an authorization error is shown.

steps.description: Click the "Submit" or "Save" button on the expense form

title: Admin can void an invoice and see status updated in invoice detail
description: Verifies an admin user can void an order and the invoice detail view reflects the voided status.

steps.description: Click the first invoice in the invoice list

title: Admin void order requires confirmation and shows voided state after confirming
description: Verifies voiding an order prompts for confirmation and, after confirming, the UI shows the order as voided.

steps.description: Click the first invoice in the invoice list

title: Admin can delete an invoice and it is removed from the invoices list
description: Verifies an admin user can delete an order and the invoice no longer appears in the invoices list after deletion.

steps.description: Click the first invoice in the invoice list

title: Admin delete order can be canceled from confirmation dialog
description: Verifies that canceling the delete confirmation leaves the invoice accessible and not deleted.

steps.description: Click the first invoice in the invoice list

title: Admin void order can be canceled from confirmation dialog
description: Verifies that canceling the void confirmation does not change the invoice to a voided state.

steps.description: Click the first invoice in the invoice list

title: Cashier cannot void an order and sees an authorization error
description: Verifies that a non-admin (cashier) user is blocked from voiding and an authorization error is shown.

title: Non-admin user sees authorization error when attempting to void from invoice detail (pre-authenticated cashier)
description: Verifies that when signed in as a cashier, attempting to void from invoice detail shows an authorization error and does not void the order.

steps.description: Click the first invoice in the invoice list
